text: Ironvale Athletic launches a swift counterattack deep from their own half, with Jonah Lindqvist advancing the ball along the right side near the halfway line. He plays a short, precise pass to Ilias Thorne positioned centrally about 7.5 metres from Redmond Rovers' goal at the left end. Thorne swiftly shoots with his foot and scores, leveling the match at 3-3.
